subject: Utility Pole Enforcement and School Budget Oversight
overview: The Council requested detailed school department data regarding staffing and enrollment ahead of budget hearings and passed a resolution seeking state authority to penalize utility companies for 'double poles.' The meeting also featured extensive public testimony regarding the Community Preservation Act and proposed property maintenance standards.

items.title: Geese Management and Cable Committee Updates
items.summary: Passed resolutions for the administration to establish an action plan for Canadian geese in public parks and to provide an update on Cable Advisory Committee appointments.

items.title: School Department Data Requests
items.summary: Passed three requests for data from the school department concerning student transfers, class size fluctuations, and a list of all new and eliminated positions in the FY2018 budget.

items.title: Utility 'Double Pole' Enforcement
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting state legislation to create a database and penalty structure for utility companies that fail to remove double poles within 90 days.

items.title: Property Maintenance Ordinance Petition
items.summary: Heard a resident petition for an ordinance establishing minimum standards for property care to address blight and safety issues, which was referred for review against existing codes.

items.title: CPA Suspension and Business District Funding
items.summary: Heard testimony from residents proposing to suspend the Community Preservation Act tax due to low state matching funds and questioning the status of $250,000 annually promised for business square improvements.

items.title: Short-term Rental Regulations
items.summary: Discussed the development of a local ordinance to regulate Airbnbs and requested an update from the state delegation on relevant pending legislation.

items.title: Condolences and Minutes
items.summary: Offered condolences to the families of Philip Harko and Peter Kolias and approved minutes from previous meetings.

items.title: Cemetery and Water Budget Transfers
items.summary: Approved funding transfers for cemetery salaries and the appropriation of $900,000 from water retained earnings for an acoustic leak detection system.

items.title: Wireless Telecommunication Towers Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a proposed zoning ordinance governing the placement and height of cell towers to the Committee of the Whole.
